messages:
Riley: Heads-up 1hr planning for copy + lead routing for Hosted / Dedicated / Private pages. Need a lightweight decision so eng can prod deploy. Can folks jump in?
Tara: I'll join. Quick ask: which single benchmark do we highlight per product page? p95 latency for Hosted, throughput for Dedicated, compliance features callout for Private?
Dev: I prefer tokens/sec for Dedicated and p95 for Hosted. For Private, a short compliance line + link to compliance pack. Keep hero lean.
Nikhil: Routing note: inbound form should set two fields: `mode_interest` and `company_segment`. Then automation decides owner. I'll sketch rules.
Hannah: Also: add a webinar CTA variant on pages that have the benchmark stat visible. Webinar copy should be neutral and show third-party comparisons.
Riley: Good. We also need the micro-survey under hero on mobile-friendly card. Two options: single-question toggle vs three-button chooser. Which is less friction?
Tara: Single-question toggle works better for mobile. Wording idea: "Which mode fits your scale & controls? Hosted / Dedicated / Private". Keep analytics tag for the click.
Dev: HubSpot pseudo-rule I propose:
```
if form.company_segment in ["enterprise", "regulated"]:
  assign = "solutions_team"
elif form.company_segment == "mid-market":
  assign = "ae_growth"
else:
  assign = "self_serve"
# set tags: mode_interest = form.mode_interest, webinar_opt_in = form.webinar_cta_clicked
# priority flag for Private -> high
```
Nikhil: Add automation: if webinar_opt_in == true -> add to 'benchmarks-nurture' workflow. Also add a lead score pulse if company_segment == enterprise and mode_interest == private.
Hannah: For webinar landing copy: headline, 3 bullets (methodology, topline result, what customers asked). CTA: "See the benchmark" and a short signup form. Keep form 4 fields max.
Riley: Microcopy choices for hero (short): A) "Fast, predictable LLM inference for product teams." B) "SLA-backed throughput for production LLMs." C) "Private deployment with audit-ready controls." We'll map each to the respective page.
Tara: I'll create A/B variants: problem-led vs trust-led. Plan: 10k sessions minimum per variant, 14 days, NA/EU.
Dev: Tracking: append `?utm_experiment=hero_v2&utm_variant=A` and a custom `X-cta-id` in the form submission payload.
Nikhil: I'll own the HubSpot field list and automation JSON. Will post by EOD.
Hannah: I'll draft webinar bullets and a short impartial subtitle: "Independent benchmarks across public model families."
Riley: Design ask: can we include a small inline stat with a tooltip linking to the bench details? Mobile-first please.
Tara: Yes. Mira (cc'd) can do that in the mock. Hannah and I will align on exact stat phrasing so legal's happy.
Dev: Small QA: ensure Private page includes KMS/HSM, audit logs, and on-prem note in micro-FAQ. One-liners only.
Nikhil: Action owners: Tara = A/B plan + headline variants, Hannah = webinar copy + stats subtitle, Dev = tracking & query params, Nikhil = HubSpot mapping & automations, Riley = micro-survey copy + prioritization. form-bot: Reminder set for review meeting in 24h.
form-bot: Reminder created: "Marketing landing copy review" in 24 hours.
Riley: Thanks all. We'll lock hero variants in review and publish the test by next Wednesday.
